decisions.reason: The source-selection rule is changed by a separate clause in message 84 and already has its own MODIFY; the visual-editing style change does not further alter it.
The complete-moment and educational-value rules are independently established by separate clauses in message 84 and are not changed by the visual-editing style decision.
Requiring polished editing and avoiding crazy effects or transitions does not necessarily change the existing caption-color rule.
The visual-editing style change does not modify the existing 30–90-second duration constraint.
Message 84 concerns a later three-clip requalification task and does not alter the requirements of the completed initial trial batch.
The polished, straightforward editing requirement does not modify the independently defined effective-hook criterion.
The source decision applies to the requalification clips and does not change the prior extended trial's batch size, source content, or guideline-compliance standard.

The requalification batch still requires three approved perfect clips; the visual-editing decision defines a separate quality behavior without necessarily changing the batch requirement's stored attributes.
